live_quantum_metrology.verdict: REAL quantum-metrology computation: over N=2->8 the ideal GHZ gain grows 4.0x (Heisenberg ~ N), but with per-qubit dephasing (p=0.2) the dephased GHZ grows only 2.05x — essentially the SQL rate (2.01x, ~sqrt(N)). Dephasing ERASES the Heisenberg *scaling* to a bounded constant (gain turns over near N~9). HONEST NULL: no quantum-sensing advantage for fusion disruptions this decade — but a real, runnable metrology tool.
